question: Does an audiobook count as reading?
scope: Listening to an unabridged book. Compare ordinary reading uses and specific skills without ranking accessibility, reading formats, or readers.

turns.text: An audiobook counts as reading because you learn the story and encounter the author's words.

claims.hint: Name another way to learn a book story.
Name another way to hear or encounter those words.

turns.text: Real reading requires eyes on written words. Listening to a voice is a different activity.

claims.hint: Name a reading method that does not need sight.

rejected.reason: That still uses visible print. Name another reading method.

claims.hint: Name spoken access that people also call reading.

turns.text: Anything that speaks the complete written text is a form of reading, even if a machine reads it aloud.

claims.hint: Name spoken text normally described as listening.
Name a machine voice used for another activity.

turns.text: Reading lets you control the pace and return to a passage. Audio just plays forward.

claims.hint: Name an audio device or control that changes pacing.

rejected.reason: That is a print tool. Name an audio device or control.

claims.hint: Name an audio control that returns to a section.

turns.text: Listening is reading when you pay full attention and understand the meaning; concentration matters more than the medium.

claims.hint: Name attentive listening or viewing not usually called reading.
Name another way to understand a message.

turns.text: Narration adds a performer's interpretation. A performed version is a different work from reading the original.

claims.hint: Name reading that also involves interpretation.
Name a performed book that preserves the original text.
